rv.q: "Much Ado About Nothing" is funny, energetic, musical, and remarkably approachable.
I could go on and on but just go see it... it's a not to be missed summer treat.

The Old Globe's latest production of "Much Ado," which opened Saturday night on the company's outdoor festival stage in San Diego's Balboa Park, is the most musical, contemporary and entertaining staging of the play that I can remember.
If a play like Much Ado represents Bill Shakespeare’s sense of humor, he would be proud of this production with its upbeat modern references and digs.
